summary: Full 0.4.2 upstream integration (48a41fcc -> 3a1be68c): synced HIP/runtime sources and Temporal Mode 2/3 headers, wired Mode 2 (low-frequency stabilization) and Mode 3 (single-pass residual enhancement + strength 0..2) into LmxxfNrRuntime/LmxxfBackend/Config/Menu/INI on the caller recording command list, rebuilt all 80 gfx1200/gfx1201 .hsaco modules (including 12 LLVM 23.1.2 wave1/wave2 modules and new c512-m32-deep/compact QKV/W16/inter-byte layouts), and verified module contract, WARP, Temporal Mode 2/3, and RX 9070 XT GPU execution.
validation: Dual-architecture 80-module rebuild (12 LLVM 23.1.2 prebuilt + 68 COMGR across gfx1200/gfx1201) from 3a1be68c, LmxxfNrRuntime.dll and OptiScaler.dll Release x64 builds, check-module-contract.ps1 (40 per arch / 80 dual), lmxxf ABI/WARP/native_temporal (Modes 0/2/3 + enhance strength 0..2), test_config_priority.py, and RX 9070 XT GPU fixed-frame oracle passed. Exact hashes and results in docs/lmxxf-042-consumer-review.md.

decisions.reason: 0.4.2 upstream sources (3a1be68c), all 80 gfx1200/gfx1201 HIP modules (including 12 LLVM 23.1.2 prebuilts), and Temporal Mode 2/3 + Enhance Strength 0..2 are integrated and verified. Project-level in-game/long-run and submit_pulse deferrals remain tracked.
decisions.validation: Dual-architecture 80-module rebuild (12 LLVM 23.1.2 prebuilt + 68 COMGR across gfx1200/gfx1201) from 3a1be68c, LmxxfNrRuntime.dll and OptiScaler.dll Release x64 builds, check-module-contract.ps1 (40 per arch / 80 dual), lmxxf ABI/WARP/native_temporal (Modes 0/2/3 + enhance strength 0..2), test_config_priority.py, and RX 9070 XT GPU fixed-frame oracle passed. Exact hashes and results in docs/lmxxf-042-consumer-review.md. Follow-up release review: canonical UTF-8/LF text fingerprints tested under Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7; raw HSACO byte changes remain detectable. The 80-module rebuild matches the previously committed object bytes; release-tier native temporal WARP and full host ci pass.
decisions.next_step: Cold-start Crimson Desert with a matching ABI6 complete package, NrInline and LmxxfAllowEnhancedBarriers; compare split and 1-5 slots in the same scene/session, checking pixels, displayed pacing, queries/layouts and long-run VRAM/retained recordings. Exercise varying external exposure/motion/depth, more model/pass/numeric/extent combinations and other adapters/drivers. Preserve person-partition semantic-mask and first-pass acceptance deferrals. Rebuild full Mochizuki source/shader package before release; authoritative release regression remains GitHub Actions. Trace sustained Mochizuki FLOAT graphics/compute segments with concurrent game waits; reproduce same-format full-compute/forced-segment differences. Validate any fix without losing HDR/FLOAT precision, temporal behavior or first-pass exports; complete native/ACO forward/reverse and paced performance matrices before claiming its inline performance accepted. GPU-armed capture-proof research is stopped by user decision; resume only when requested, within the documented 90-minute/2-hour limit, with <=3% throughput gap and proven failure-path input/history safety. Preserve all other existing deferrals.
